target_description.input_format: Arbitrary bytes interpreted as 12 u64 values (little-endian, 96 bytes minimum), reduced to canonical field elements
assertions: Determinism: permute(state) called twice produces identical output
All output elements are in canonical range [0, p)
target_description.critical_finding_criteria: Non-deterministic output (permute(x) != permute(x) for same x)

campaign_methodology.seed_corpus_source: Zero state, all-ones state, reference test vectors from poseidon_reference.rs

campaign_results.notes: 60-second fuzzing campaign executed successfully. 156k executions at 2.6k exec/s with no crashes or panics. Poseidon permutation determinism verified — permute(state) called twice always produced identical output. All output elements remained in canonical range [0, p). Corpus stabilized at 25 entries.
